items.title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
items.summary: Markets have been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US midterms.
items.content:
Hundreds of billions of dollars in market value has been wiped from major tech firms in the US and Asia in a stock market rout after the US midterm elections sparked concerns of a slowdown in artificial intelligence development.

Shares in firms across the tech and AI sectors plummeted following Democratic wins after election campaigns run on slowing AI.

The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite index closed down by more than 5.5%, losing an estimated $2.5tn (£1.9tn) in market value, according to Dow Jones data, while other key US stock indexes also saw big losses in their worst days since 2025.

The sell-off comes on top of broader concerns about whether the huge amounts being spent on AI will pay off.

In Asia, tech-heavy indexes fell sharply on Friday morning as firms that make the computer chips and other equipment that power AI saw their shares slide.

The Nikkei 225 in Japan was 6% lower in early trading as shares in memory chip maker Kioxia lost over 12.6% and rival Tokyo Electron slipped by 9.5%.

South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix fell by more than 11.5%, while Samsung was down by nearly 10%.

The sell-off in Seoul sent the Kospi index plunging more than 8.5%, triggering a so-called circuit breaker, a mechanism that temporarily halts trading to curb panic selling.

Taiwan's Taiex dropped by more than 8.3%, with chipmaking giant TSMC falling by nearly 8.5%.

It marks a "continuation of worries" over the level of spending on AI infrastructure, said MarketWatch chips analyst Britney Nguyen.

Democrats in races across the US campaigned to slow the growth of data centres and AI, and there were dozens of measures on ballots around the country aimed at restricting the development of the hubs crucial for powering the technology.

They won both the US Senate and House of Representatives in Tuesday's midterms, taking control of Congress for the rest of President Donald Trump's presidency.

Texas' Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned heavily against data centres, pledging a moratorium on new construction in the sector.

Live: What can Democrats do with control of Congress? We answer your US midterms questions

Food, fuel and taxes – can the Democrats actually make life cheaper?

Boebert, billionaires' tax and other midterms races still to watch

In a social media post, Trump blamed the slide on his political opponents.

"The Stock Market suffered one of the Worst Days in History based on the results of the Election," he said.

"Remember, it wasn't Republicans, it was Dumocrats. Do not fear, however, we will soon, one way or the other, be BIGGER AND STRONGER THAN EVER BEFORE. MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN!"

Some Democrats have argued that AI has grown too big without any safeguards or oversight and have promised, with their new power in Congress, to change that.

"Americans don't want Big Tech oligarchs wrecking the environment, gutting jobs and threatening humanity's future. NATIONAL DATA CENTER MORATORIUM NOW," Democrat Senator Bernie Sanders said in a post on X on Thursday.

Shares in companies heavily exposed to AI data centres, including crucial chipmakers and semiconductor manufacturers, fell sharply on Thursday, highlighting investor concerns that had already been growing.

Nvidia shares slid more than 9%, knocking more than $400bn off the firm's market value.

Other chipmakers also suffered, with AMD and Micron both dropping by more than 17%. Intel shares also dropped, down 10.3%, while memory card maker SanDisk plunged more than 22%.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which tracks the performance of 30 of the largest companies involved in semiconductor production, fell by more than 12%.

Shares in Elon Musk's companies SpaceX and Tesla also plunged, falling 8% and nearly 11% respectively and shaving more than $300bn off the firms' market value on Thursday.

Musk had spent nearly $450m backing Republican campaigns, including at least $45m in support of Ken Paxton for the Texas senate seat, but Texas was turned blue in the Democratic tsunami on Tuesday night.

In total, the so-called magnificent seven tech companies, including Apple, Nvidia and Tesla, have shed a trillion dollars in value in a single trading day.

The stock falls also hit other major US stock indexes. The S&P 500 index fell by 4.4% by the end of trading, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average erased gains made on Wednesday to close down more than 3.4%.

The Nasdaq Composite fall was so large it is now in what market watchers call correction territory, which is where an index or company value falls at least 10% below its recent high.

A backlash over data centres is another threat to the AI juggernaut

Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing

Susannah Streeter, chief investment strategist at Wealth Club, said the steep sell-off on the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 was sending shockwaves into other markets.

"Fresh panic over the AI trade has hit Wall Street hard," she said.

"Fears that the vast sums poured into AI infrastructure may not deliver the returns investors have been banking on are now colliding with the prospect of a sharp slowdown in data centre construction."

Greater scrutiny of data centre approvals, and their impact on the environment and electricity bills could delay projects and raise costs across the industry, said Charu Chanana, Chief Investment Strategist at Saxo.

While both political parties are keen to ensure the US' dominance in the technology, "there is a difference between supporting AI development and allowing infrastructure to expand at any cost or pace," she said.

Some tech leaders have said they were caught off guard by the backlash against data centres in the midterms.

OpenAI president and co-founder Greg Brockman said he believed everyone had been surprised by the reaction to data centres, and more work needed to be done to ensure communities were on board.

"A lot of our shift over the course of this year has really been to realise that from San Francisco trying to build infrastructure in Texas, Georgia, and other places, you can't just tweet and say: 'This is going to be good.' You need to be in those communities," Brockman said at the WSJ Tech conference in Napa, California on Wednesday evening.

Meta's president Dina Powell McCormick said that the industry needed to put more effort into selling AI as a good idea.

"I think we need to double and triple down on telling the story," she told the WSJ conference.

Alongside the immediate impacts of the US mid-term elections, some investors have become concerned that AI shares could be in a bubble that is due a correction .

These firms you've never heard of are feeding fears the AI bubble could burst

items.title: Le borse oggi, 6 novembre. Crolla il Nikkei, Seul sospende le contrattazioni
items.summary: Tonfo in Asia per i timori che i cambiamenti negli Usa possano colpire gli investimenti chiave nell'intelligenza artificiale
items.content:
Crollano le borse in Asia per i timori post elezioni di midterm negli Stati Uniti. Il Nikkei è caduto di oltre il 6% in apertura. Ancora peggiore l’avvio di Seul: il -8,5% ha fatto scattare un meccanismo di sospensione automatica delle contrattazioni per 20 minuti.

Seul peggio di Tokyo, -8,5% e contrattazioni sospese per 20 minuti

Seul peggio di Tokyo, -8,5% e contrattazioni sospese per 20 minuti

L'indice Kospi di Seul è crollato dell'8,5%, attestandosi a 4.923 punti, facendo scattare un meccanismo di sospensione automatica delle contrattazioni per la durata di 20 minuti. La borsa sudcoreana segue il timore che cambiamento nel panorama politico in Usa possa colpire gli investimenti chiave nell'intelligenza artificiale, considerati fondamentali per la crescita economica, e l'apertura nettamente negativa di Tokyo a -5,1%.

Il Nikkei, l'indice di punta della borsa di Tokyo, è caduto di oltre il 5% in apertura dopo il crollo di Wall Street (-5,5% in chiusura), dopo i risultati delle elezioni americane che potrebbero rallentare gli investimenti nei data center dedicati all'intelligenza artificiale. L'indice di riferimento Nikkei è sceso del 5,1% a 56.930 punti nelle prime contrattazioni.

items.title: Democratic socialist defeats incumbent Karen Bass in Los Angeles mayor's race
items.summary: The results mean America's two most populous cities - New York and Los Angeles - will be led by democratic socialists.
items.content:
Democratic socialist Nithya Raman has toppled incumbent Karen Bass in the race for mayor of Los Angeles.

Raman's win stunned political watchers in California after she entered the race as a long-shot candidate against Bass, a political heavyweight who previously served in Congress and had never lost a race for political office.

Raman has frequently been compared to New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani. Both are democratic socialists and ran on progressive platforms.

Her win solidifies that America's two biggest cities will now be led by democratic socialists, which include some of the most high-profile politicians in the US, such as Mamdani and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.

Los Angeles was always likely to have a Democratic mayor but the question in the city - the second most populous city in the US - was just how left voters would be willing to go.

Bass, also Democrat, announced that she had called and conceded to Raman in a post on social media on Thursday, writing "while this is not the outcome we hoped for, the people of Los Angeles have spoken."

"Moving this city forward is what Los Angeles needs from all of us," Bass wrote. "I love Los Angeles. I believe in Los Angeles. And I will continue to ensure the promise of a better life belongs to all of us."

Boebert, billionaires' tax and other midterms races still to watch

Food, fuel and taxes – can the Democrats actually make life cheaper?

'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat

Raman, a member of city council and Indian immigrant, ran on a platform of change and fixing the "broken status quo and the politicians who failed them over and over again".

She ran on cutting homelessness, increasing housing in the city, saving Hollywood jobs from continued cuts and protecting residents from immigration enforcement efforts. Raman also vowed to fix the city's many issues, including helping beautification efforts, fixing roads and even helping bring back nightlife in the city.

The major issue in the race, however, was the LA fires, which killed dozens of people and razed neighbourhoods across the area in 2025. Bass faced intense political fallout over her absence during the emergency and the city's response to the disaster.

The next mayor in LA will oversee hosting the Super Bowl in 2027 and the 2028 Summer Olympics.

Raman entered the race as a long-shot candidate but slowly shored up support, especially from younger voters, before besting reality star Spencer Pratt in the primary race earlier this year.

Raman's win over Bass has all the appearances of echoing voter sentiment across the US as part of sweeping Democratic wins, including in deep-Republican country that hadn't seen liberal leaders in decades.

Washington DC also elected democratic socialist Janeese Lewis George as its new mayor, furthering progressive leadership in another major US city.

US President Donald Trump was asked at the White House about the wins by politicians on the left flank of the Democratic Party and said, "If you go by history, it's going to be a disaster".

Such candidates have become a focal point of attacks by Republicans.

Bass had been a prominent member of Congress before becoming LA's first black female mayor. Her roots are closely tied to LA and its history, even working as a community organiser during the violent 1992 riots over police brutality in the beating of Rodney King, who was black.

items.title: Samsung Secrets: i Samsung AI TV si trasformano in una console di ultima generazione, serve solo un controller
items.summary: Il Gaming Hub di Samsung nasconde un vero PC da gaming all'interno del televisore. Ecco cosa serve per giocare in 4K a 60 fps (e oltre) direttamente dal cloud ... Leggi tutto
items.content:
Quando si pensa di acquistare una nuova console da gioco o un PC per il gaming in 4K, ci sono sempre più ostacoli: hardware introvabile e prezzi fuori controllo. Eppure, se in salotto c’è un televisore Samsung AI TV, quella “console” è già pronta all'uso e non ha bisogno di alcuna “scatola" aggiuntiva posizionata sotto lo schermo. Si chiama Samsung Gaming Hub ed è uno degli elementi più potenti — e spesso meno esplorati — della piattaforma Smart TV Tizen. Non è una semplice raccolta di app, ma un ambiente che trasforma il TV in una stazione da gioco di alto livello, azzerando la necessità di acquistare hardware dedicato.

Il principio alla base del Gaming Hub è semplice: l'elaborazione grafica non avviene sul televisore, ma su server remoti ad altissime prestazioni. Il TV riceve un flusso video a bassissima latenza e invia i comandi impartiti dal controller.

A differenza di qualche anno fa, la maturità delle piattaforme di cloud gaming di oggi garantisce una qualità sovrapponibile a quella di una macchina fisica di altissimo livello , e i Samsung AI TV supportano i migliori servizi oggi disponibili per qualità e titoli disponibili:

Dal Gaming Hub puoi sfogliare direttamente il catalogo aggregato dei titoli disponibili, ricevere raccomandazione dei giochi che ti possono interessare, con indicazione chiara dei servizi di cloud gaming in cui li puoi trovare. Basta selezionare il gioco, la piattaforma e sei pronto a iniziare.

Accedere a centinaia di titoli con il Gaming Hub è più semplice di quello che credi: basta collegare un controller. Il Gaming Hub abbatte qualsiasi barriera perché non richiede un gamepad proprietario : Samsung AI TV supportano infatti i principali controller per console e Bluetooth: c’è la compatibilità nativa via Bluetooth o USB via cavo per i controller Xbox, Xbox Elite, PlayStation DualSense e DualShock 4, Amazon Luna.

Come si collega? Dalla schermata principale del Gaming Hub, basta selezionare l'icona del controller per avviare la ricerca Bluetooth ed effettuare l'abbinamento in pochi secondi. Collegando un cavo USB a una porta del TV o del box One Connect, il riconoscimento è immediato e plug-and-play.

E se sei un amante dei giochi in prima persona e non ami il controller da gioco non c’è nessun problema. Puoi anche collegare mouse e tastiera , sia via Bluetooth che tramite le porte USB, e giocare esattamente come da PC. E siccome anche l’audio è importante, con i Samsung AI TV puoi collegare direttamente anche cuffie e auricolari Bluetooth, con gestione dell'audio a 360° e modalità a bassa latenza.

Se invece possiedi già un PC da gaming rig o una console di ultima generazione (come PS5 o Xbox Series X), il Gaming Hub si trasforma nel centro di controllo per le sorgenti esterne via HDMI 2.1. I Samsung AI TV sono equipaggiati di quattro ingressi HDMI 2.1 completi che offrono accesso a tutte le funzionalità aggiuntive dello standard pensate per il gaming.

Collegando un PC da gaming, i modelli Micro RGB, Neo QLED e OLED Samsung più recenti spingono il refresh rate oltre lo standard dei 120 Hz, raggiungendo perfino i 165 Hz , garantendo la fluidità e l’input lag tipici dei monitor da eSports. Grazie al supporto nativo per VRR (Variable Refresh Rate), AMD FreeSync Premium Pro e, sulla gamma OLED, alla compatibilità NVIDIA G-Sync, lo schermo del TV adatta in tempo reale la sua frequenza ai framerate del PC o della console, azzerando tearing e micro-scatti per una schermata di gioco sempre incredibilmente fluida.

Grazie alla funzione ALLM (bassa latenza automatica), i Samsung AI TV riconoscono automaticamente la console o il PC e impostano automaticamente la modalità gioco. Grazie all’IA, il TV riconosce il tipo di gioco e ottimizza automaticamente l’immagine per garantire la resa migliore in base al genere. Premendo l'apposito tasto sul telecomando si richiama poi la Game Bar, un menù dedicato che consente di visualizzare in tempo reale il frame e di accedere rapidamente a tutte le funzioni di gioco. Tra le ultime novità troviamo la funzione MiniMap Auto Detect che sfrutta l’intelligenza artificiale per riconoscere la mini mappa di gioco e la ingrandisce in un riquadro dedicato. Il Virtual Aim Point sovrappone invece un mirino virtuale su schermo per aiutarti ad ottenere maggiore precisione negli sparatutto in prima persona.

items.title: MoofTCP – A modern replacement for MacTCP on 68k Macs
items.summary: Article URL: https://github.com/matthewmrichter/mooftcp Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50386789 Points: 5 # Comments: 0
items.content:
A modern, memory-lean replacement for MacTCP on 68k Macs running System 6.

MoofTCP is a drop-in replacement for Apple's MacTCP. Programs written for MacTCP run on it unchanged, but underneath it is a fresh TCP/IP stack written from scratch in portable C, with its own control panel, installer and DHCP client. It was built for a Mac Classic with 4 MB of RAM, so every byte counts.

MacTCP is wonderful, but it is old, and on a 4 MB Mac Classic with a SCSI Wi-Fi/Ethernet adapter like BlueSCSI it can be slow to answer, hungry for memory, and awkward to set up. MoofTCP aims, in this order, for:

...all while using no more resident memory than MacTCP does .

To go back to MacTCP, run the installer and click Remove . The Read Me file in the release has the details, including how to switch between MoofTCP and MoofTCP Lite.

StuffIt Lite 3.6 is tested as working for expanding the .hqx packages.

Tested on a real Mac Classic (System 6.0.8, 4 MB, BlueSCSI v2 WiFi with DaynaPORT) and in the Snow emulator.

Have a program that doesn't work? Please open an issue (see below).

MultiFinder grows the system heap on demand, so free memory varies more there.

MoofTCP keeps a small diagnostic log in memory. If a program misbehaves but the Mac keeps running, run MoofDiag right away (it is in the release's diagnostic tools download), and open an issue with the MoofDiag.out file it writes next to itself, plus a note about what you were doing. Feel free to ask your LLM to analyze the codebase and the diagnostic output as well and to submit fix PRs.

You only need Docker. The pinned Retro68 cross-compiler image is pulled automatically.

release.sh also needs hfsutils, macutils, unar, gcc and Python 3.

The portable core and the glue logic are tested on your desktop with gcc and CMake (AddressSanitizer and UBSan are on by default):

The emulator tests (Snow) need Apple system software and the BlueSCSI DaynaPORT image. Those are not in this repository and you must supply them yourself; the scripts in scripts/ ( setup-home.sh , golden-stage.sh ) show what is expected.

Bug reports, compatibility reports ("program X does/doesn't work") and pull requests are welcome. For code changes, please read CONTRIBUTING.md and run the host tests first (see above). CLAUDE.md is a detailed map of the code and its rules. Security problems: see SECURITY.md .

MIT . "MacTCP" and "StuffIt" are trademarks of their owners and are used here only to describe compatibility. MoofTCP contains no Apple or third-party code; building it uses Apple's interfaces as shipped in the Retro68 toolchain.

items.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
items.summary: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.
items.content:
Pope Leo XIV is beginning a lengthy trip to Latin America just three weeks after surgery for lung cancer - a tour that includes a much-anticipated "homecoming" to Peru where he was a priest for many years.

The Vatican says no extraordinary measures are being taken in relation to the Pope's health, describing him as a "71-year-old who has undergone an operation" not someone with a "permanent medical condition".

It was Leo himself who revealed last month that doctors had discovered a tumour during a routine scan. The growth was removed along with the lower lobe of his right lung and his medical team then confirmed the cancer had not spread.

At a briefing in Rome ahead of the trip, which takes in Uruguay and Argentina as well as Peru, a spokeswoman stressed that Pope Leo had "fantastic stamina" and was "extremely enthusiastic" about the schedule which he had "personally confirmed... with no changes".

"The Vatican's message with this trip is, 'that was a short episode and now we're back on track'," Professor Massimo Faggioli of Villanova University told the BBC, pointing out that the Pope has had a busy return to work since his surgery.

"We have seen him in these last few days making speeches, audiences and so on. He seems in great shape. That was important."

The 12-day tour would be demanding for anyone, though. It incorporates multiple long-haul and local flights and covers thousands of miles from the Amazon to the Andes.

The starting point will be Uruguay, where the number of Catholics has fallen away steeply in recent years and which is getting its first Papal visit in four decades.

Leo then heads for Argentina, homeland of Pope Francis, his predecessor.

"This visit is also a homage to Francis, who didn't make it to Argentina [as pope]," says Father Fernando Laguna, the rector of Santa Maria Addolorata, Argentina's national church in Rome.

"When this visit by Pope Leo was announced, it filled all of our hearts with joy," he told the BBC. "I always thought he would go, despite his illness. I don't think he ever thought of calling it off!"

The priest is installing a big screen inside the church in Rome to allow parishioners to follow all the key moments of the trip from afar. The building is already decked out with posters declaring Pope Leo is welcome in Argentina. "We're waiting for you!", one proclaims.

This leg of the Pope's journey - which includes meetings with heads of state as well as religious events - could be the most politically sensitive. President Javier Milei once called Pope Francis "evil on earth" and a "communist" for promoting a doctrine of social justice to help the poor. In turn, Argentina's bishops have criticised Milei's harsh austerity measures, making sweeping cuts to social spending.

But Milei has already welcomed Pope Leo, writing in a post on X that Argentina awaits "with immense joy". Millions are expected to turn out to greet him.

The highlight of the trip is undoubtedly saved for last, when Pope Leo reaches Peru - described by the Vatican as a return to his roots.

Born in the US, the then Robert Prevost spent almost 20 years in Peru, on and off, and even has Peruvian citizenship. That time is seen as fundamental to shaping his papacy.

His schedule includes a return to the diocese of Chiclayo where he was ordained bishop in 2014 and remained until Francis moved him to the Vatican almost a decade later.

He will also travel to Cusco, former capital of the Inca Empire, to say Mass more than 3,000m above sea level before heading to Pucallpa in the Amazon.

In all three countries, the Vatican says the Pope will have meetings with survivors of clerical sexual abuse - an issue which clouded a 2018 visit to Chile and Peru by his predecessor.

"This is how the papacy reconnects with Latin America after Francis, whose visits to the region were not always seamless," is how Professor Faggioli sees it.

He believes Pope Leo has a strong sense of the unity of the Americas as one continent. "Democracies are in trouble there, so there are so many things he can address," he suggests.

"The big question then is the United States. There's no question he wants to go. So will he travel when [President Donald] Trump is still in office? I'm sure they're thinking about this."

items.title: Inkling 2 Small
items.summary: Article URL: https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50386338 Points: 66 # Comments: 28
items.content:
Today we are introducing our second model generation with Inkling 2 Small. It is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 594B total parameters, 17B active, and supports image inputs and variable effort.

Inkling 2 Small far surpasses our previous models’ scores on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 31, reflecting gains in performance on agentic coding, vision, knowledge work, and reasoning. The increase in capabilities comes from improvements made at every step of our training process, including more efficient pre-training and a large, unified RL run.

Inkling 2 Small will initially be available through Tinker, with closed weights, following the approach we outlined in a safe path to open weights . We intend to make the full weights available under an Apache 2.0 license next week after the completion of external safety testing and red-teaming.

You can try Inkling 2 Small on Tinker Playground today. The model is also available for fine-tuning and sampling on Tinker; checkpoints will be downloadable with the release of Inkling 2 Small’s weights.

Inkling 2 Small is more capable across the board than our first generation, particularly in long-horizon autonomous work.

Inkling 2 Small’s vision and agentic capabilities enable it to incorporate visual feedback to iteratively build and refine websites, games, and 3D designs with interactive elements.

Inkling 2 Small was trained with RL on hundreds of thousands of long-horizon coding tasks across multiple agent harnesses and context-compaction strategies. We increased the quality of our synthetic coding data pipeline and moved beyond unit-test rewards alone; many tasks included an agentic RL grader that evaluated how the model approached the problem, not just whether its code passed. We also tested early checkpoints of Inkling 2 Small on OpenCode under the name Fledge-Alpha to assess our model’s performance on coding tasks in the real world.

The result is a model that is both stronger at coding and easier to use inside real agent loops. Inkling 2 Small improves on usability compared to Inkling: it follows instructions better, considers changes carefully, and verifies its work without being asked.

Beyond conventional software tasks, Inkling 2 Small was also trained on long-horizon autoresearch tasks. This included agentic GPU kernel optimization and ML tasks such as post-training a model autonomously, all run across a range of GPU architectures.

To demonstrate its end-to-end autoresearch performance, we tested Inkling 2 Small on a task Proximal built for one of our internal benchmarks. Inkling 2 Small autonomously trained Qwen3.5-4B on Tinker to predict various time series such as weather and Wikipedia page views. It started by analyzing the tasks and writing its own evaluator, experimented with training datasets and recipes, and tried various approaches to SFT and RL, while debugging the process as it goes. After 4.5 hours of work and $426 in Tinker spend, the trained model has more than doubled its forecasting score.

Inkling 2 Small processes image inputs using a 292M-parameter vision encoder based on Perception Encoder Bolya et al., 2025 . . We use 20×20-pixel patches with 2×2 spatial pooling, and interleave image patches with text tokens. The model demonstrates strong visual capabilities across multiple categories, including OCR, grounding, infographic interpretation, and visual reasoning.

The model uses vision in the loop to interpret and validate the visual coding output it generates. Pending the release of its weights, it is set to be the top open-weights model on DesignArena .

items.title: Brazilian Credit Guarantor Fund Data Breach Affecting PII and Payout Data
items.summary: Article URL: https://www.fgc.org.br/comunicado Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50386104 Points: 20 # Comments: 2
items.content:
O FGC informa sobre um incidente de segurança envolvendo dados pessoais tratados pela entidade e esclarece o que foi identificado, as providências adotadas e os cuidados que recomendamos.

Identificamos acesso não autorizado a informações pessoais em ambientes relacionados aos processos internos do fluxo de pagamento de garantia do FGC. Até o momento, não foi identificada nenhuma evidência de que os dados tenham sido divulgados ou utilizados de forma indevida. Também não foi identificada nenhuma perda financeira decorrente do evento. A investigação prossegue, com apoio de empresas especializadas, para esclarecer a extensão do acesso e verificar se houve cópia, divulgação ou utilização indevida das informações.

A suspeita de incidente foi identificada em 26 de outubro de 2026. Desde então, foram adotadas restrições de acesso aos ambientes envolvidos, bloqueio de contas indevidas, preservação de evidências e revisão das permissões e dos controles de segurança.

A Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD) foi devidamente comunicada, em conformidade com a legislação vigente. A apuração continua, com apoio de especialistas, e as informações complementares pertinentes serão encaminhadas à Agência conforme o avanço das investigações. Os titulares afetados também foram comunicados.

Reunimos aqui as informações disponíveis e confirmadas nesta etapa. Caso a apuração identifique novos elementos relevantes relacionados a dados pessoais ou as medidas de proteção, atualizaremos as orientações pelos canais oficiais.

As informações envolvidas podem ser utilizadas para tornar contatos fraudulentos mais convincentes, inclusive em tentativas de uso indevido de identidade ou de obtenção de pagamentos e outras informações pessoais.

Por essa razão, enviamos comunicação aos titulares afetados e recomendamos atenção redobrada a mensagens, ligações e e-mails que mencionem informações pessoais ou relacionadas ao pagamento da garantia, especialmente quando realizadas por pessoas que se apresentem como representantes do FGC ou de outras instituições. Qualquer pessoa, ao receber algum contato suspeito, pode entrar em contato com o FGC.

Destacamos alguns cuidados importantes para a segurança de todos:

Desconfie de contatos que solicitem pagamentos, senhas, códigos de autenticação ou instalação de aplicativos, mesmo quando mencionarem informações corretas sobre você;

Não clique em links em mensagens suspeitas. Para acessar informações do processo de pagamento, use diretamente o aplicativo do FGC;

Confirme informações relacionadas ao processo de pagamento de garantia pelos canais oficiais do FGC;

Preserve as mensagens suspeitas e registre ocorrência perante as autoridades competentes se identificar tentativa de fraude. Neste caso, avise imediatamente o FGC.

A segurança da informação é prioridade para o FGC que possui arquitetura robusta de proteção, além de equipes especializadas que atuam no monitoramento, na detecção e resposta a ameaças. Os ambientes utilizavam mecanismos de autenticação e controle de acesso. Após a identificação do incidente, restringimos os acessos aos ambientes envolvidos, desabilitamos contas indevidas, reforçamos o monitoramento e preservamos evidências para a investigação. A revisão de permissões e a validação dos controles de segurança permanecem em andamento.

O tema está sendo tratado com a máxima prioridade, tendo como principal preocupação o apoio aos titulares de dados afetados e a revisão contínua dos mecanismos de proteção de dados e de segurança da informação.

Atualizações e orientações sobre o incidente serão disponibilizadas nesta página: fgc.org.br/comunicado .

Para obter mais detalhes sobre dados pessoais ou esclarecer dúvidas específicas, entre em contato com nossa central de atendimento pelo e-mail: atendimento.credores@fgc.org.br .

Seguimos à disposição para prestar esclarecimentos e apoiar você nas medidas de prevenção.

Fundo Garantidor de Créditos - FGC Encarregado de dados – DPO privacidade@fgc.org.br

items.title: Delhi's toxic winter air is back - is the Indian capital prepared for pollution?
items.summary: The Delhi government has announced a four-month winter action plan, but experts say that won't be enough.
items.content:
There are two cardboard boxes in Meenu Rana's living room in Delhi. One is filled with Diwali decorations and twinkling lights. The other holds air purifiers.

"The mornings have already started feeling stuffy. It will get worse in the coming days, so it's better to be prepared," says the 43-year-old teacher.

She is not alone. Every year, as winter and the festive season approach, residents of India's capital begin preparing for something far less celebratory: months of breathing polluted air.

Delhi and its satellite cities record some of the world's highest pollution levels through the year. But as winter sets in, the air often becomes unbearable.

Falling temperatures and slower winds trap pollutants close to the ground instead of allowing them to disperse. Smoke from crop residue burning in neighbouring states adds to emissions from vehicles and factories, as well as construction dust. Firecrackers used during festivals often worsen air quality.

The result is noxious air and a familiar question: why does pollution return year after year, and why hasn't more been done to tackle it?

This year, however, the Delhi government announced its Winter Action Plan months before the worst of the smog arrived. The plan is in place from 1 November to 28 February, covering the months when pollution usually spikes.

Experts have called this a step in the right direction, noting that in previous years measures were often rolled out only after the air quality got too bad to ignore. However, they say this by itself won't be enough, calling for more holistic, long-lasting measures.

Just days after the plan came into effect, the city is slipping back into a depressingly familiar pattern .

This week, a grey haze hangs over Delhi, along with a distinct smoky smell that residents unwillingly recognise. People complain of irritation in their eyes and difficulty breathing, and coughs and sneezes are heard everywhere.

For those who can afford them, air purifiers have become a household necessity. Outdoors, people wear masks or cover their faces with cloth, trying to protect themselves from the worst of the pollution.

Tackling pollution was among the promises made by the governing Bharatiya Janata Party during its election campaign last year. Its winter action plan is now a major test of that pledge.

The plan restricts the entry of older, more polluting vehicles registered outside Delhi and denies fuel to vehicles without a certificate which shows they meet emission standards. Demolitions and outdoor construction work that generate dust have been temporarily banned.

Private vehicle use is being discouraged - the government has asked offices to allow half of their employees to work from home, introduced staggered office timings for its staff and doubled parking charges. It says it will also strengthen pollution monitoring and enforcement and promote public transport and electric vehicles.

These measures are separate from the Graded Response Action Plan (Grap), which is overseen by the federal Commission for Air Quality Management.

Grap introduces restrictions in stages, with stricter measures kicking in as pollution levels rise. This week, its second stage is in force, restricting the use of diesel generators and burning of coal and firewood.

Expert say on paper, these actions collectively provide a roadmap for responding to rising pollution levels but their success ultimately depends on enforcement.

"There are a lot of positive changes as far as planning is concerned, but when it comes to execution, we probably still stand at the same level," says Parthaa Bosu, strategic adviser at the Environmental Defense Fund, a non-profit group focused on delivering climate solutions.

"If we want to reduce pollution, we need to set targets for every sector - including power generation, industry and transport - not just vehicle entry, construction and stubble burning," says Manoj Kumar, an analyst at the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air.

"We know how much each sector and each state contributes to pollution. We can set targets to reduce emissions from each of them over the next five years."

Bosu points out that an issue which does not get enough attention is secondary pollutants - when gases in the air react with sunlight, water vapour and other substances to form harmful particles that contribute to pollution.

"Pollution is not just caused by biomass burning or vehicles," he says. "Dust being stirred up from the ground, coal and fly ash, materials burned at brick kilns and the large-scale burning of urban waste are also contributing to the problem. And much of this is still not being stopped."

Delhi's pollution problem is also affected by what happens outside the city . Pollutants travel into Delhi from neighbouring states and other parts of northern India, worsening the situation, Bosu explains.

This means that measures taken by Delhi can achieve only so much. Tackling the problem requires neighbouring states and the wider northern region to work together, he adds.

'I panic every time she coughs' - Delhi's toxic air is making its children sick

Why India caps pollution reading at 500 when the air is far more toxic

Living in Delhi smog is like watching a dystopian film again and again

In the meantime, pollution is harming people's health every day.

During winter, government monitoring stations in Delhi frequently record Air Quality Index (AQI) readings above 300, classified as "very poor".

On particularly bad days, readings can reach 500, the highest point on India's scale. That does not mean pollution cannot rise further, only that domestic trackers do not record it. International trackers such as Swiss-based IQAir have recorded readings close to 1,000 on some days.

The World Health Organization recommends average PM2.5 levels over 24 hours should not exceed 15 micrograms per cubic metre. In Delhi, levels are often at more than 25 times that limit during pollution season.

Dr Manoj Goel, pulmonology unit head at Fortis Memorial Research Institute near Delhi, says these tiny particles "can penetrate deep into the lungs and enter the bloodstream, triggering inflammation and affecting multiple organs".

Even short-term exposure can cause throat irritation, coughing, wheezing and breathlessness. It can also worsen existing heart and lung conditions.

A 2025 report , external by the Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago estimated that air pollution could reduce life expectancy in Delhi by up to 8.2 years.

For residents, the challenge is not just limited to breathing. The restrictions also disrupt everyday life.

Delhi is closely connected to its satellite towns, Noida and Gurugram, with thousands of people travelling between them every day for work. Long queues form at the city's borders as vehicles are stopped and checked, leaving commuters stuck in traffic for hours.

While the new rules offer some hope, frustration is growing.

Protests, political arguments and court interventions have become part of the annual cycle. But despite public pressure and government measures, the pollution returns every winter.

Rana keeps her windows closed and curtains drawn, and has added more indoor plants.

The arrival of another winter fills her family with dread, but unlike many others , they are not planning to move out of Delhi.

"I would have left the city long ago had there been an option, but my son has his school, my husband and I have our jobs as well, which makes it practically impossible," she says.

"What option do we have? It is unfair but we will have to live with it."

items.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
items.summary: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.
items.content:
California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on death row in the state, changing them instead to life in prison.

"We can now let these offenders die in obscurity while we forever remember and honour the victims," he said in a letter.

The decision to spare death row inmates is largely symbolic in a state that has not executed an inmate since 2006, though experts say it could save millions of dollars in court costs each year. Only 13 inmates have been executed since voters reinstated the death penalty in 1978.

The decision comes as Newsom, the Democratic leader of the most populous US state, has been discussed as a possible 2028 contender for president.

Newsom, who is term limited, is winding down his final months in office. Fellow Democrat Xavier Becerra is projected to take over after the midterm elections on Tuesday.

Newsom explained in his letter that he is exercising his constitutional clemency authority to commute the sentences to life without the possibility of parole.

"After nearly 30 years in public office, I have come to understand the limits of what government can justly accomplish," Newsom said. "I take this action because I firmly believe that state-sanctioned killing is incompatible with California's values, undermines the foundations of our legal system and diminishes each of us".

California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates. Newsom had previously ordered a halt to the death penalty in the state in 2019.

Describing his decision as a difficult but "righteous action", Newsom said that although many Californians feel that those who commit brutal crimes deserve to die, he has concluded that "the state cannot morally kill them".

He said that by every measure, California's system for administering the death penalty "is a failure", and that it has not and cannot be fairly applied, resulting in the conviction of innocent people.

Life without the possibility of parole is the most severe punishment he can lawfully impose and that the state can ethically enforce, he said.

He acknowledged that his clemency action will anger and hurt some Californians and said that it will "always weigh heavily on me".

"As governor, I alone bear responsibility for this decision and its impact, just as I alone would bear responsibility for each execution," he wrote.

"For this reason, I am compelled to follow my conscience and, as authorised by our Constitution, take this action for the welfare of the State of California."

Because individual states have the power to prosecute crimes and order executions, much of the power lies with state governors.

Bernard E Harcourt, a law and civil liberties professor at Columbia University, told the BBC that it is not unprecedented for a potential presidential candidate to come out as an abolitionist in the run up to elections - despite the overall popularity of the death penalty in the US.

He noted that François Mitterrand did precisely that in his presidential campaign in France in 1981, taking "the higher ethical ground and was rewarded by the public for that".

"I detect a very similar ethical positioning in Governor Newsom's statements about the commutations. And here too, it may well be something that the voters respect," he said.

Newsom's decision comes after the high-profile botched execution of a woman in Tennessee in late September and while executions have been on the rise in the US. There are three executions scheduled for Thursday in Indiana, Florida and Alabama.

At least four of seven judges on the California Supreme Court will have to sign off on the commutations, CalMatters reported.

It is unclear how Newsom's decision will affect condemned inmates like Keith Doolin, 53, who was sentenced to death in 1996 for murdering two sex workers, Inez Espinoza and Peggy Tucker, and shooting four others. He maintains his innocence.

Doolin lived on death row at San Quentin for decades, until he was moved to another prison in 2025 when the governor announced the state would reform the prison for all but those on death row .

Doolin's mother, Donna Larsen, told the BBC that the news of Newsom's commutations - which includes Doolin - brought mixed emotions.

"At least the execution chamber will not be reconstructed, and no more killing by the people of the state of California," she said.

Anthony D Romero, the executive director of the American Civil Liberties Union, applauded Newsom's action.

"These commutations reflect what justice demands: an end to a racist, error-prone, and inhumane punishment that has burdened California for far too long," Romero said.

"By taking this step, Gov. Newsom has affirmed that the death penalty has no place in California and he showed real courage by confronting racialised injustice head-on."

Nathan Hochman, the top prosecutor in Los Angeles County, said that while Newsom has the power to commute sentences, only state legislature or voters can eliminate the death penalty.

"Californians have been asked on two separate ballot initiatives to abolish the death penalty and both times they have chosen to keep it for the most serious crimes," Hochman said in a statement.

On the federal level, President Donald Trump, a long-time supporter of the death penalty, has described capital punishment as "an essential tool for deterring and punishing those who would commit the most heinous crimes and acts of lethal violence against American citizens".

In 2020, during his first term, he ended a nearly two-decade moratorium on the federal death penalty, by ordering 13 executions over a six-month period.

While the moratorium returned under President Biden, on the first day of Trump's second term in 2025, he signed an executive order that re-instated the death penalty.

No federal executions have been carried out since he signed it, however. In the US, both the federal government and local states authorities can order executions.

The death penalty is legal in 27 states, but has been abolished in 23 states and Washington DC, according to the Death Penalty Information Center, a national non-profit.

California, which primarily uses lethal injection for executions, used to house male death row prisoners in San Quentin State Prison north of San Francisco, and female inmates in the Central California Women's Facility in the Central Valley.

But a 2016 ballot measure allowed for their transfer to other facilities that provide a necessary level of security, according to the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation.

US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution

items.title: Trump non si arrende: 'Le elezioni negli Usa sono truccate'
items.summary: Il tycoon pronto con i blitz prima di diventare 'anatra zoppa', dalla difesa ai migranti
items.content:
Dopo aver riconosciuto la sconfitta alle midterm ed essersi congratulato con i democratici Donald Trump torna con un attacco sulle frodi elettorali. Un'affermazione generica sul sistema americano ma che fa capire come il presidente non abbia intenzione di arrendersi. E prima che inizi a 'zoppicare' dopo la clamorosa disfatta dei repubblicani, voglia sfruttare al massimo il tempo che manca all'insediamento del nuovo congresso a maggioranza democratica, il 3 gennaio del 2027.

Nel gergo politico angloamericano questa fase si chiama il "lame-duck sprint" (letteralmente lo "scatto dell'anatra zoppa"), e quello di quest'anno si preannuncia da record come nel 1974 quando, subito dopo le dimissioni di Richard Nixon e le elezioni di midterm , il Congresso uscente approvò ben 138 leggi sostanziali in appena un mese.

"Le nostre elezioni sono così truccate, non avete idea", ha detto il tycoon parlando con i giornalisti nello Studio Ovale. Non un attacco preciso contro questa tornata ma un generico affondo sulla corruzione del sistema che richiama la retorica dei suoi ultimi comizi. Sta di fatto che il 3 gennaio si insedierà il nuovo Congresso e le priorità del tycoon in questo periodo di transizione sono abbastanza chiare.

Innanzitutto garantire i fondi per la difesa, questione critica e urgente a causa dei conflitti in corso e dell'avvicinarsi di scadenze legislative improrogabili. Trump e il Pentagono si stanno battendo per una spesa militare senza precedenti, pari a 1.500 miliardi di dollari, una maxi manovra che si scontra con l'opposizione non soltanto dei democratici ma anche all'interno del Grand Old party. La Casa Bianca sta studiando un taglio da 400 miliardi di dollari ed elaborando un piano di riserva che prevede un bilancio di 1.100 miliardi di dollari.

Ma alla fine si dovrebbe arrivare ad un compromesso nella forma di un intervento d'emergenza mirato e bipartisan, attorno ai 100 miliardi di dollari. L'altra questione in cima all'agenda del tycoon è l'immigrazione. Trump intende attuare una strategia fortemente incentrata sui poteri e le prerogative presidenziali per proteggere e promuovere le sue politiche intransigent i. I suoi consiglieri stanno già elaborando piani alternativi volti ad aggirare completamente il Congresso e a consolidare la sua stretta attraverso decreti ed ordini esecutivi. Stesso ragionamento vale per dazi e nomine, con una particolare attenzione alla Corte Suprema.

Dopo la vittoria a valanga alle elezioni di metà mandato, i democratici nutrono qualche speranza di scalfire la supermaggioranza conservatrice del massimo tribunale americano. Ma se i repubblicani riuscissero a convincere uno dei due giudici vicini alla pensione, Samuel Alito e Clarence Thomas, a lasciare in queste settimane il presidente potrebbe fare una nomina lampo e rimanere in controllo della Corte. Alito ha fatto già sapere che non intende fare un passo indietro anche se questo farà perdere ai repubblicani la breve finestra a disposizione . Una volta che il nuovo Senato a maggioranza democratica prenderà formalmente il controllo Trump non sarà più in grado di far confermare alcun giudice, al massimo tribunale e in qualsiasi altra corte federale.

items.title: La Juve batte l'Az Alkmaar con brivido finale. Cade il Milan, a San Siro vince il Ferencvaros
items.summary: I bianconeri salgono a quota 10 in classifica, in Conference 1-1 dell'Atalanta con il Kairat
items.content:
Az Alkmaar-Juventus 1-2 LA CRONACA LIVE nel match valido per la quarta giornata della fase campionato di Europa League

All'88 ALKMAAR-Juventus 2-1! Rete di Meerdink! Oukfir ruba palla a destra a Kelly, imbuca per Dijkstra che dal fondo accomoda al centro per Meerdink, per il quale è un gioco da ragazzi insaccare da zero metri!

Al 37' Alkmaar-JUVENTUS 0-2! Rete di Kolo Muani! Pressing forsennato del francese che recupera palla in avanti e serve Woltemade. Il tedesco la restituisce al compagno che col sinistro fulmina De Busser!

Al 19' Alkmaar-JUVENTUS 0-1! Rete di Koopmeiners! Proprio lui, il gol dell'ex! Grande azione di Kolo Muani che salta netto un avversario sulla destra e accelera, sul lato corto dell'area serve un cioccolatino a Koopmeiners che di prima intenzione infila la sfera con il sinistro all'angolino basso!

(di Emanuele Pastorella) Dopo il 2-0 al Napoli, l'1-2 di Alkmaar: la Juventus piazza la seconda vittoria consecutiva tra campionato ed Europa League. Il Koopmeiners bianconero vince il derby con il fratello Peer segnando il gol che apre la sfida, Kolo Muani ipoteca la vittoria già nel primo tempo ma nel finale i ragazzi di Spalletti rischiano troppo . Meerdink la riapre all'88', l'Az trova anche il pari nel recupero ma viene annullato per fuorigioco: la Juve sale a quota 10 e può esultare, il tecnico dovrà lavorare sul vertiginoso calo nel finale.

Spalletti aveva preannunciato il tridente e si presenta con Kolo Muani e Alajbegovic con Woltemade attaccante centrale, a centrocampo si rivede Sarr e in difesa riposa Bremer con Gatti che diventa il capitano di serata nel reparto completato da Lucumì e Kelly. A centrocampo c'è l'uomo più atteso, Koopmeiners, che affronta da ex il fratello Peer. "Due fratelli, un amore" è lo striscione che viene dedicato ai due giocatori dalla curva dell'Az, che proprio in queste settimane stanno ultimando un libro per bambini in cui raccontano la propria storia. Ad Alkmaar si ritrovano da avversari, il bianconero ci impiega meno di 20 minuti per diventare decisivo: Kolo Muani si trova benissimo largo a destra e sfonda, il suo servizio in area trova Teun che di sinistro batte De Busser. L'esultanza è contenuta, come aveva anticipato alla vigilia, mentre Spalletti chiede ai suoi di continuare e tenere alta l'attenzione. La Juve è ancora pericolosa con un destro potente di Aljabegovic che sfiora la traversa, poi inizia ad abbassarsi e vive una decina di minuti in sofferenza: una punizione di Byskov da ottima posizione viene ribattuta dalla barriera, Kwakman ha due buone occasioni ma in entrambi i casi non riesce a pungere.

Così, nel momento migliore dell'Az, ecco che i bianconeri colpiscono sull'asse Woltemade-Kolo Muani, con il tedesco che serve il francese bravo a realizzare il raddoppio con il mancino. Spalletti non cambia nulla per l'inizio la ripresa, la sua squadra ha tre potenziali occasioni per chiudere definitivamente i conti ma si perde sul più bello. Le sostituzioni arrivano all'ora di gioco, il trio Dijkstra-Clasia-Smit funziona meglio del tandem Cabal-Boga, eppure i ragazzi di Echteld non riescono a impegnare Vicario nonostante alzino notevolmente il proprio baricentro e il neoentrato Smit calci in curva un rigore in movimento. Per le battute finali Spalletti si affida ai centimetri di Bremer per respingere gli assalti e concede il debutto a Ekhator, è proprio il difensore brasiliano a opporsi alla conclusione pericolosa di Oufkir.

Gli olandesi continuano a spingere, Kelly e Cabal pasticciano sull'out mancino e Meerdink realizza il gol della speranza a due dalla fine. Al primo dei quattro di recupero arriva anche il 2-2 di De Wit ma è annullato per fuorigioco , la Juve continua a vivere in apnea fino al triplice fischio finale . I 10 punti in quattro gare permettono di rimanere in linea con le prime otto per andare direttamente alla fase ad eliminazione diretta, domenica a Firenze serviranno altre risposte per confermare che la crisi è passata.

items.title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
items.summary: Article URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/107757 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50385272 Points: 529 # Comments: 182
items.content:
I receive dozens of scam emails per day because claude code divulged my email to arbitrary 3rd parties in the User-Agent request header while conducting web searches without my permission. This should not be a setting with opt-out or opt-in behavior, it needs to be removed from the harness entirely. It is not for the good of anyone involved: it does nothing for services which dislike agentic traffic, does not preserve my anonymity on the web, and is a goldmine for scammers. I am migrating my company to Pi with OpenRouter since I have no faith in anthropic preserving my privacy.

Hi folks! We introduced a built-in mod called cc-plugin-privacy to deterministically block this behavior in v2.1.317 and later - definitely let us know ASAP though if there's a gap in the checks introduced by that mod. I'll try to get that built-in mod source available like we do for the other built-in mods here .

The built-in privacy mod is enabled by default, you can turn it off via /plugins .

Well, no one is responsible when everything is vibed. Blame the agent.

Well, no one is responsible when everything is vibed. Blame the agent.

What kind of person even thinks of shipping this as a feature? 😆

To clarify, nobody implemented this "share email addresses to websites" as a feature. Models can be highly unpredictable. This is why deterministic checks around model behavior are so important, and why we need to solve alignment. To explicate the scenario:

Anyhow, the privacy mod is now source available , so folks can see what the check is that prevents this model behavior. Feedback is highly desired!

Feedback: Please curate the 5000+ issues in this repo instead of only paying attention to what goes viral on Twitter/Reddit/HN. The original issue #81138 is from July: 5-month turnaround for a heckin plugin. Can't an agent triage and act on the existing issues? You can literally sort issues by emoji count and 80/20 it.

items.title: Al via il nuovo Quotidiano Nazionale, 'patto con i lettori: liberi di darci torto'
items.summary: Da La Russa a Meloni per l'evento a Roma. Del Vecchio: "Punto sull'editoria"
items.content:
Parte da oggi l'avventura del nuovo Quotidiano Nazionale e all'evento di presentazione alla Galleria di Arte Moderna a Roma l'editore Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio assicura che intende puntare sempre più sul settore. "Assolutamente sì", risponde ai cronisti che gli chiedono se intende fare nuovi investimenti, prima di parlare di un "grande inizio". All'evento, oltre all'erede del fondatore di Luxottica che è arrivato con la figlia Bianca in braccio, tanti esponenti politici e istituzionali, dal presidente del Senato Ignazio La Russa alla premier Giorgia Meloni con la sorella Arianna, fino ai ministri Matteo Salvini, Matteo Piantedosi e Antonio Tajani ea al sottosegretario all'Editoria Alberto Barachini. Presenti anche la sottosegretaria alla Cultura Lucia Borgonzoni. "Quando un giornale si rinnova e cresce, cresce la democrazia", ha detto quest'ultimo. Per l'opposizione sono intervenuti Elly Schlein, Giuseppe Conte, Angelo Bonelli e Matteo Renzi. Il sindaco di Roma Roberto Gualtieri si è detto felice per la scelta della capitale come sede. Tra gli altri anche il presidente dell'Agcom Giacomo Lasorella, il presidente della Fieg Andrea Riffeser Monti, Bruno Vespa e Fedez, vicino a Del Vecchio ormai da alcuni mesi, e Giovanni Malagò.

Durante l'evento Del Vecchio, l'amministratore delegato Gabriele Benedetto, il direttore editoriale Mario Orfeo e la direttrice Agnese Pini hanno tracciato i contorni del progetto editoriale. "Cominciamo oggi perché ogni inizio è anche una dichiarazione d'intenti. Il 5 novembre 2026 è all'indomani delle Midterm americane, che in altri tempi avremmo documentato come un naturale tagliando di metà mandato della più grande democrazia occidentale, ma che oggi segnano il punto d'avvio dell'anno elettorale che verrà", ha scritto oggi Pini nel suo editoriale dal titolo "Un giornale nuovo e un patto con gli elettori. Liberi di darci torto". Nella prima pagina una sola grande foto con Donald Trump sotto un cielo plumbeo, attorniato dai giornalisti, e il titolo di apertura "L'America scarica Trump. È guerra alla Casa Bianca". A contornarla i richiami degli articoli delle pagine interne con gli interventi del filosofo Luciano Floridi, dello scrittore Edoardo Nesi e del presidente della Biennale di Venezia Pietrangelo Buttafuoco e un fumetto di Gipi. In taglio basso l'editoriale sulle elezioni di Midterm di Mattia Feltri. Il quotidiano ospita anche il pensiero della premier Giorgia Meloni sul rapporto con gli Stati Uniti. "Al nuovo Qn hanno deciso di partecipare alcune fra le menti più brillanti del nostro tempo e del nostro Paese", ha spiegato ancora Pini nel suo editoriale. "Nell'epoca delle verità imposte, riteniamo più credibile il dubbio - ha sottolineato -. L'indipendenza di un giornale si riconosce soprattutto perché decide di pubblicare anche quando quel fatto smentisce le sue convinzioni".

items.title: Marguerettaz presidente Valle d'Aosta, 'autonomia e dialogo con Roma'
items.summary: Eletto in sostituzione di Renzo Testolin, dichiarato ineleggibile dalla Corte d'Appello
items.content:
A un anno dal debutto della legislatura, la Valle d'Aosta cambia in corsa il governatore. Aurelio Marguerettaz, commercialista di 63 anni, esponente di primo piano dell'Union valdôtaine (Uv), è stato eletto presidente dal Consiglio regionale nella serata di giovedì. È sostenuto dagli autonomisti (Uv e Centro autonomista) e da Forza Italia, che, unico caso nel Paese, ha deciso di entrare nel governo senza gli (ex) alleati del centrodestra.

Il cambio al vertice arriva al termine di una crisi durata circa una settimana, dopo la traumatica caduta dell'ex presidente Renzo Testolin, dichiarato ineleggibile il 27 ottobre dalla Corte d'Appello di Torino per avere superato il numero massimo dei mandati previsti da una norma regionale.

La sfida del nuovo esecutivo sarà "di rendere visibile con risultati concreti ciò che l'autonomia consente di fare per i valdostani, una scuola che rimane aperta in una vallata, delle cure accessibili, una famiglia che trova un'abitazione, un'impresa che può investire e un giovane che decide di abitare qui", ha detto Marguerettaz presentando il programma.

Autonomia ad Aosta, ma anche dialogo a Roma. Il neo eletto vuole infatti avviare con il governo "relazioni fondate sulla lealtà istituzionale, rispetto e soluzioni" e ha invitato i gruppi che si riferiscono ai partiti nazionali "di maggioranza o di opposizione" di mettersi a disposizione della comunità. Un appello a cui le forze politiche di opposizione hanno risposto in maniera bipartisan.

Il Pd, alleato dell'Union valdotaine nella scorsa legislatura, ha letto nella relazione del neo presidente "molti elementi condivisibili che confermano indirizzi che avevamo contribuito a costruire". Anche la Lega è "disponibile al confronto, ma senza firmare cambiali in bianco". Fratelli d'Italia si augura che "finisca il muro contro muro che ha caratterizzato il precedente governo". Tra le voci fuori dal coro quella della capogruppo di Avs, Chiara Minelli, che ha ricordato che Marguerettaz è il decimo presidente valdostano in dieci anni.

"Questo ennesimo cambio - ha detto - non è soltanto il frutto dell'instabilità che caratterizza la nostra Regione", ma una "crisi" che ha avuto origine dal "mancato rispetto di una legge regionale, sancito da un Tribunale ordinario e da una Corte d'Appello. Una legge che non si è voluto prendere in considerazione, nonostante la norma fosse chiara".

items.title: Manovra sotto attacco. Sindacati convocati a palazzo Chigi il 13 novembre
items.summary: Si lavora alla previdenza ad hoc per il settore difesa. Scontro Bertolaso-Lega su Quota64. In piazza i lavoratori della scuola, anche la polizia pronta
items.content:
Prima ancora che cominci la battaglia degli emendamenti, c'è chi prepara quella degli striscioni contro la manovra. E poco importa se il governo ha convocato i sindacati a Palazzo Chigi per il 13 novembre. La protesta, infatti, continua a scandire il calendario delle tensioni: l'11 novembre scenderanno in piazza i sindacati della scuola, il 20 toccherà alla Cgil. E anche i poliziotti minacciano di scendere in strada per una previdenza dedicata che ancora non c'è.

Un malcontento che dai cancelli degli istituti e dalle questure raggiunge le stanze della maggioranza, dove sulle pensioni non c'è segno di conciliazione. La Lega non molla sull'uscita a 64 anni, trovando però in Lombardia il muro dell'assessore al Welfare Guido Bertolaso, che suggerisce di dirottare quelle risorse sugli ospedali. "Credo che oggi a 64 anni non ci voglia più andare nessuno in pensione, io ne sono un esempio", osserva, liquidando la bandiera del Carroccio.

Secca la replica dei leghisti lombardi: "Prima di fare politica sulle pensioni, Bertolaso faccia funzionare ciò che ha in carico". Un terreno previdenziale sul quale Forza Italia promette di muoversi anche per dare risposta agli uomini in divisa, con un intervento stimato in 48 milioni annui. La richiesta avrebbe trovato ascolto anche tra le fila di Fratelli d'Italia, con la Ragioneria incaricata di studiare una soluzione.

La prima miccia si accende tra i banchi di scuola: Cisl, Uil, Snals e Anief chiamano i lavoratori in piazza l'11 novembre, il 16 sarà la volta delle assemblee negli istituti, il 20 dello sciopero della Flc Cgil con università e ricerca. Nel mirino oltre 14mila posti tra docenti e Ata persi in tre anni, secondo la Cgil. Non si può rispondere al calo delle nascite svuotando le scuole, avvertono i sindacati. Lega e FI aprono, almeno a parole, a un "cambio di rotta". Più fredda FdI. .

E anche i costruttori dell'Ance presentano il conto al governo: mancano i fondi contro il caro materiali e gli ultimi crediti Superbonus vengono spalmati su dieci anni. Ma è sulla sanità che il conto si fa complesso: le Regioni avevano chiesto 6,5 miliardi aggiuntivi per il 2027, la manovra ne mette 2,4, oltre al miliardo già previsto. "La coperta, ahimè, è corta", ammette anche il governatore del Lazio e uomo del centrodestra, Francesco Rocca, reclamando risorse e flessibilità ma rinviando "i giudizi definitivi" alla fine dell'iter.

Una cautela che circola anche tra i giorgettiani della Lega, impegnati a gettare acqua sul fuoco e a fare scudo al ministro dell'Economia, da giorni bersaglio di rivendicazioni incrociate. A far rumore sono anche le divise, accusando il governo di aver "tradito la parola data" sulla previdenza dedicata. "Non è una pretesa di privilegio", spiega il segretario del Siulp, Felice Romano, evocando "una stagione di protesta senza precedenti". Fino all'avvertimento più delicato per un esecutivo che della sicurezza ha fatto una bandiera: "Stavolta nelle piazze manifesteranno i poliziotti".

A presidiare il dossier è FI - sotto l'egida del sottosegretario alla Difesa, Matteo Perego, e del senatore Maurizio Gasparri - che il 12 novembre incontrerà i sindacati per disinnescare la protesta, puntando anche sulla sponda Nato: le pensioni militari concorrono infatti al bilancio integrato della Difesa. E l'attivismo azzurro si allarga anche al fisco, con la richiesta di correggere l'exit tax sui super ricchi che lasciano il Paese, limitandola alle plusvalenze maturate in Italia e tutelando chi si trasferisce nell'Ue.

A offrire nuove munizioni alle opposizioni è invece il capitolo della difesa. Secondo Milex, nel 2027 la spesa militare supererà per la prima volta i 40 miliardi, destinando la cifra record di 17,2 miliardi agli armamenti. In due anni le risorse per le infrastrutture Nato e le forze di pronto intervento ammonteranno ad altri 865 milioni. Una manovra "da cestinare", la bolla Angelo Bonelli, puntando il dito contro la priorità data alle "armi" e non "al diritto alla salute". Una linea condivisa da Elly Schlein e rincarata da Giuseppe Conte: per le guerre si trovano miliardi, sostiene, ma non per i "progetti di vita".

items.title: Tencent Launches Hy4, One of the Leading Open-Source AI Models
items.summary: Article URL: https://www.tencent.com/tencent-launches-hy4-joining-the-ranks-of-the-worlds-leading-open-source-ai-models/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50383963 Points: 86 # Comments: 2
items.content:
Tencent today announced the release of Tencent Hy4, its latest-generation large language model, marking a significant leap in performance and capabilities that now ranks it among the world’s leading open-source AI models. Tencent Hy plans to release model weights and system cards in the coming days, reinforcing its commitment to responsible open-source AI development, with a focus on cybersecurity and biological safety.

The new model also introduces visual understanding capabilities for the first time, alongside major improvements in instruction following, long-context comprehension and long-horizon agentic tasks, delivering stronger overall performance across a diverse set of applications.

Through advanced visual understanding, reasoning, and tool-calling capabilities, Hy4 now supports a broader range of tasks, including fine-grained image processing, complex chart analysis, and mathematical visual reasoning.

Additionally, Hy4 introduces computer-use capabilities for the first time, enabling it to interact with both command-line interfaces and graphical user interfaces to perform a wide range of work and everyday tasks. The model has undergone specialized training on professional software such as Blender and CAD, significantly enhancing its ability to plan and execute long-horizon and sophisticated tasks.

Leveraging significant advances in its foundational capabilities and deep model-product co-design, Hy4 unlocks a broader range of real-world productivity scenarios:

Office Productivity & Collaboration : Hy4 has significantly enhanced the user experience on Tencent WorkBuddy. Evaluation benchmarks on WorkBuddy show an average performance score of 83.18 and a pass rate of 96.15 percent, with Hy4 ranking first place in nine out of twelve scenarios within the mainland Chinese market. In practical use, Hy4 balances efficiency and effectiveness for visual creative tasks, 3D scene construction, and web development. Furthermore, it delivers marked improvements in document presentation, stability, and usability for human-AI collaborative tasks on WorkBuddy.

Leveraging enhanced in-context learning capabilities, Hy4 excels at understanding complex information from diverse sources. Integrated with WeCom via WorkBuddy, Hy4 connects with daily workflow data across chats, emails, documents, calendars, and meetings. When managing multiple projects simultaneously, Hy4 automatically tracks project history and recent developments. It identifies outstanding tasks, flags upcoming meetings that require preparation, and monitors approaching deadlines, helping users prioritize effectively and stay aligned on important follow-ups. In addition, new team collaboration capabilities powered by Hy4 will be introduced with the upcoming release of WorkBuddy’s “Projects” feature.

Hy4 has also been optimized for professional financial analysis. By training on thousands of specialized workspaces and tens of thousands of high-quality tasks derived from real-world scenarios, the model gains a deep understanding of expert workflows in fund research, securities analysis, and quantitative investment strategies.

In a rigorous blind evaluation conducted by the Tencent Hy team in partnership with Tencent Financial Technology, Hy4 emerged as the top-performing open-source model. The assessment involved 213 financial professionals, including 153 experts from leading external institutions, approximately 70 percent of whom possessed more than five years of industry experience. Based on performance across 579 real-world financial tasks, Hy4 achieved the highest overall performance score.

Evaluation scores: Hy4 (3.04), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (2.97), Kimi K3.1 Pro (2.68), and GLM-5.3 (2.68).

In addition, Hy4 achieved a 12.03 percentage-point improvement over Hy4 Preview in the internal Investment Research Agent Benchmark (iRaB) evaluation conducted by financial AI company Rabyte.

To enhance the model’s real-world applicability across financial and other workplace scenarios, Tencent Hy has also introduced targeted search optimisation that focuses on retrieving up-to-date information, integrating multiple information sources, and verifying factual consistency. In internal evaluations, Hy4 reduced its hallucination rate from 12.95% in the Hy4 Preview to 7.2%, while errors caused by unsupported assumptions fell from 23.1% to 5.6%.

Frontend & Game Development: Hy4 is optimized for high-complexity tasks, including intricate business logic, state management, front-end and back-end orchestration. This ensures that generated interfaces are not only visually polished but also fully functional. Furthermore, through collaboration with Tencent Interactive Entertainment Group (IEG) professional developers, Hy4 has significantly advanced its game development capabilities. By deeply integrating with major engines like Unreal Engine (UE), Unity, and Godot, the model now supports complex game logic and multiplayer implementations. Compared to Hy4 Preview, Hy4 improved by 19.1 percent in GameDev and 9.8 percent in GameLogic benchmarks.

Scientific Research: Hy4 combines advanced reasoning, scientific programming, and long-horizon task execution to support complex, end-to-end research workflows. Validated with TenureTrail, which assessed 123 executable tasks across seven disciplines, the model demonstrated superior performance in mathematical construction, physical modeling, environmental and earth sciences, systems engineering, and socio-economic decision-making.

Hy4 is advancing into the next stage of Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) to further enhance its model research and development capabilities. Leveraging the Hyra 2.0 harness, Hy4 optimized the pre-training infrastructure for smaller models sharing the same architecture. Additionally, the Hy team has open-sourced two foundational models developed with Hy4 and Hyra 2.0 for single-cell representations (HyCell) and the physics fields (HyPDE). These tools are designed to provide the research community with robust, reusable assets for scientific discovery.

Tencent Hy is committed to advancing responsible open-source AI, incorporating safeguards throughout model training and release, with a strong emphasis on cybersecurity and biosafety to support the safe and responsible use of AI.

Cybersecurity: Hy4 is trained on defensive security data, prioritizing proof-of-concept (PoC) development and vulnerability remediation. The model incorporates reverse engineering and penetration testing for analysis purposes. However, offensive materials related to exploitation are explicitly excluded from the training dataset.

Cybersecurity experts from Tencent’s Xuanwu Lab and Keen Security Lab conducted security assessments covering cryptographic reverse engineering, binary deobfuscation, vulnerability exploitation, and more. The assessments found no significant concerns regarding Hy4’s offensive cybersecurity capabilities in the areas evaluated.

Biosafety : Based on internal expert reviews, Hy4 demonstrates strong foundational biological knowledge; however, its capabilities in open-ended experimental design are more limited compared to frontier models.

Hy4 is currently available across Tencent Cloud TokenHub, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, WeCom’s AI Assistant (Dayuan), ima, and more. Additionally, the model’s API is being made available via third-party platforms such as OpenRouter, Hermes, and OpenCode. Integration efforts are underway for other Tencent products and platforms, including QQ, Honor of Kings, Game of Peace, WeRead, and Tencent News.

Guided by a core commitment to practical AI, Hy4 continues to push the boundaries of AI performance while delivering exceptional cost-effectiveness. Despite significant performance improvements over Hy4 Preview, Hy4 maintains the same pricing: approximately US$0.90 per million input tokens, US$2.70 per million output tokens and US$0.045 per million cached input tokens.

Hy4 Flash is scheduled for release soon and will deliver greater cost-efficiency for users who prioritize high-value applications.

From November 4 to 15, WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy will be available for free. In addition, Hy4 will be available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub at 50% off its standard pricing, with this offer running through December 31, 2026.
